Run several GBLUP scenarios from cv_scenarios()

Source: R/asr_gblup.R
asr_scenarios.Rd

Run several GBLUP scenarios from cv_scenarios()

Usage

asr_scenarios(
  sc,
  ginv,
  scenarios = c("st_sp", "st_mp", "mt_sp", "mt_mp"),
  dir = ".",
  tag = deparse(substitute(ginv)),
  ...
)

Arguments

sc

Output of mintyr::cv_scenarios().

ginv

Inverse genomic relationship matrix.

scenarios

Scenarios to run. "mt_bt" (one trait as a different trait per group, two groups) is fitted with residual_cov = "diag" and without rp, since no individual has records in both groups.

dir

Folder for the workbooks <scenario>_<tag>.xlsx; NULL writes nothing.

tag

Label used in the file names; defaults to the name of ginv.

...

Further arguments for asr_gblup() (e.g. fixed, inbreeding).

Value

A named list of asr_gblup() results.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
res <- asr_scenarios(sc, ginv, fixed = ~ hhys, inbreeding = inbreeding)
} # }
